definitions.explanation: A symbol in musical notation that represents the pitch and duration of a sound. Also refers to the sound itself that the symbol represents.

examples.japanese: {音符|おんぷ}が{多|おお}くて{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: There are many notes and it's difficult.

examples.japanese: {楽譜|がくふ}の{音符|おんぷ}を{一|ひと}つずつ{読|よ}んでいく。
examples.english: I read the musical notes on the sheet music one by one.

examples.japanese: {四分|しぶん}{音符|おんぷ}と{八分|はちぶん}{音符|おんぷ}のリズムを{練習|れんしゅう}した。
examples.english: I practiced the rhythm of quarter notes and eighth notes.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{音符|おんぷ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}を{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: The children are learning how to write musical notes.

notes:
TYPES OF NOTES:
・{全|ぜん}{音符|おんぷ} - whole note
・{二分|にぶん}{音符|おんぷ} - half note
・{四分|しぶん}{音符|おんぷ} - quarter note
・{八分|はちぶん}{音符|おんぷ} - eighth note
・{十六分|じゅうろくぶん}{音符|おんぷ} - sixteenth note

COLLOCATIONS:
・{音符|おんぷ}を{読|よ}む - to read notes
・{音符|おんぷ}を{書|か}く - to write notes
・{音符|おんぷ}が{読|よ}めない - cannot read music

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{休符|きゅうふ} - rest (silence in music)
・{楽譜|がくふ} - musical score
・{音程|おんてい} - pitch interval
